assets.name: Ecosystem synchronisation loader
assets.accessibility: Provide an accessible name such as RevenueFlow ecosystem synchronising for meaningful instances; hide decorative instances from assistive technology. Respect prefers-reduced-motion and provide a static fallback.
assets.notes: Approved signature loading motif. Three connected module nodes travel around a shared empty centre on three orbit paths while the complete loader revolves around its central vertical axis; no central logo or graphic. Module glyphs remain upright. Use as an indeterminate loading/activity indicator only; do not imply measured progress or successful completion.
